Giving this review after studying 1 months + experience. 
First of all, the environment here is very disturbing. If you are thinking of stopping and studying in the study room or Lab room u'll face a lot of trouble between 11-4 pm bcuz SSC+Bank student's both get collaborating.
If we talk about the faculty, all the teachers teach well but I have a little problem in maths because I'm not able to pick it up and there is only one faculty for each subject on both SSC and Bank segment. 
Reasoning, English even Mathematics teacher is fully supportive and approachable to solve the problem of solution of any chapter but I feel that 85% of my classmates or other Batchmates also want the faculty to hire another maths teacher as an option for students.
There are formalities in the name of Mock, everyone sits on offline mode for test & cheating aLot while test & then ranks are given on this basis.
I want to give you a personal advice, if you want to come here or any coaching then try to first study yourself because the teacher runs syllabus very quickly & a new student like me does not cover it at all Topics change in 2-3 maximum 4 classes, hence neither revision is done nor is there any way to understand anything, only 1-2% of the mains questions are conducted here.
Apart from the infrastructure and quality of books material The behaviour of teachers is very good, even that of the HOD, but according to me the HOD will have to be a little strict because the environment is really very disturbing. If you are studying by stopping then here .
